faqs.q: Is Devarko an Australian company, and where are you based?
faqs.a: Yes. Devarko is an Australian software development studio based in Hobart, Tasmania. We are backed by the team that runs seven live client platforms plus Cargonio, our own freight ERP. Our main focus is Melbourne and Victoria, and we also serve businesses across Australia, from Sydney to Perth. All work is delivered remotely, so your location is never a barrier.

Launch starts from AUD $3,900 for a 5 to 7 page custom-coded site with SEO foundations, local SEO setup, analytics and training. Business starts from AUD $6,900 and adds more pages, a blog engine, lead capture flows and copy support. Platform, for custom web applications, starts from AUD $14,500 and is scoped individually. Every package is itemised in full on the Packages page.

faqs.q: Can you fix or take over an existing website?
faqs.a: Yes. We start with a technical review of the current site, tell you plainly whether it is worth keeping, and quote either a fix or a rebuild at a fixed price. Either way you keep full ownership of your domain, content and code.

faqs.q: Do you only build websites, or do you handle SEO too?
faqs.a: Both, and they are priced separately on purpose. The build is a fixed price. SEO is an optional month-to-month plan from AUD $990/month with no lock-in contract, so you can add it later or cancel any month. Technical SEO and structured data are done by the same engineers who built the site.

faqs.q: Do you use WordPress or page builders?
faqs.a: No. Every site is custom-coded in Next.js, React or Laravel by our engineers, which is why our own site scores in the high 90s on PageSpeed. You still get a simple way to update your content, and we train you on it at handover.
